name: zdi_build_blend_verts_from_connectivity
description: zDi::BuildBlendVertsFromConnectivity builds per-vertex blend offsets from polygon connectivity, explicit exclusions, and a minimum shared-reference threshold.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel/zDi source-cluster pass.
The original helper assumes valid self, entry arrays, vertex-index lists, and exclusion indices; the native smoke exercises valid recovered geometry inputs.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x483f80 validates a fastcall helper with self in ECX, excludedVertexIndices in EDX, and blendY, excludedVertexCount, and minSharedVertexCount on the stack. It reallocates self->blendVerts to self->vertCount zVec3 entries, allocates two int arrays, clears both arrays, marks explicit exclusions, counts references from every entry->vertexIndices list using entry->flagsAndIndexCount & 0xff, disables vertices whose reference count is below minSharedVertexCount, writes each blend vertex as (0, blendY, 0) or zero, frees the temporary arrays, sets flag bit 0x08, stores blendScale=1.0, and mirrors vertCount into blendVertCount.

The native smoke verifies reference-count gating, explicit vertex exclusion, zero x/z offsets, y offset assignment, flag preservation with bit 0x08 set, blendScale reset, and blendVertCount mirroring vertCount.
